name: Definition card
description: "What is X?": a headline and up to three numbered cards that explain it, on the brand's paper. A carousel's second slide or a single explainer. Ported from the automatos-social definition family.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. WHAT IS|AN AGENT?

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

card_1_body.label: Card 1 text
card_1_body.description: One or two sentences under it.

card_2_body.label: Card 2 text
card_2_body.description: One or two sentences under it.

card_3_title.label: Card 3 heading
card_3_title.description: The heading of card 3. Leave empty for none.

card_3_body.label: Card 3 text
card_3_body.description: One or two sentences under it. Leave empty for none.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Swipe to know more. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.headline: WHAT IS|AN AGENT?
sample_data.card_1_body: A chatbot replies. An agent acts: it plans, uses tools, loops on results and drives toward a goal.
sample_data.card_2_body: Perceive the input, reason about it, pick an action, run it, observe the result, and repeat until done.
sample_data.card_3_body: A model to think with, tools to call, and a loop that keeps running until the goal is met.
